repo.name: GLPenFind
repo.description: Independent UK price index for private weight-care pens. Every pharmacy that publishes a price, per dose, with the date it was read.

apps.description:
GLPenFind is an independent price index for private weight-care pens in the
UK. It lists what each registered pharmacy publishes for a consultation, per
dose, and links every figure to the page it came from.

Every pharmacy is listed at every dose. Where a pharmacy publishes no price
for a dose, the card says so rather than hiding it, so the gaps are visible
instead of silently dropped.

The home-screen widget shows the cheapest published price at your chosen dose
and the date it was read, straight from the bundled index — no network, no
account, nothing stored about you.
apps.summary: UK weight-care prices from every registered pharmacy
